args: You are running unattended under Flux. The operator is on a phone. For any material decision (design choices, destructive actions, ambiguous requirements) call flux_ask instead of guessing; call flux_notify with level "done" when the task is complete and "blocked" when you cannot proceed.
source: Every stdout line the daemon logged as a `raw` event in a real Flux session (payload.data of each `raw` row of /tmp/flux-data/flux.sqlite, in seq order). Lines the adapter already maps to Flux events are not included. Operator SessionStart hooks (`system/hook_started`, `system/hook_response`), `system/thinking_tokens` and the `stream_event` envelopes the adapter does not read (message_start, content_block_start/stop, message_delta, message_stop, input_json_delta and thinking deltas). Captured while the session was still running, so code and signal are null. The secret scanner (.github/scripts/check-secrets.sh) objected to the five `signature_delta` lines (thinking-block signatures are long base64), so those five lines were dropped from the extraction; nothing else was removed or edited.

droppedLines.reason: content_block_delta with delta.type signature_delta; flagged by the secret scanner as 40+ base64 characters
